spans.s: --a son of कृष्ण and भद्रा. भा. X. ६१. १७.
--the son of शिवस्वाति and father of गोमती- putra. भा.
(I)--a son of श्वफल्क and गान्दिनी. भा. IX. २४. १६; Br. III. ७१. १११.
--a बृहद्रथ king who ruled for ५० years; with him were ३२ kings commencing with बृहद्रथ altogether a
years of rule. Br. III. ७४. १२१; वा. ९९. ३०८. [page१-098+ ३२]

. ३०.
Took part with Bali in the देवासुर war.
2: Ib. VIII. १०. २२.
A दानव with मनुष्य धर्म।
3: वा. ६८. १५.
Known for music.
4: वा. ६९. ७३.
(II)--the son of Mitra and रेवती. भा. VI. १८. 6.

. २४; 4. 2; १२. २१.
Came once to the व्रज of Nanda in the form of a terrific bull. Gopas and gopis got afraid as also the cattle there; attacked कृष्ण who vanquished him.
2: भा. X. ३
(IV)--a son of Vaivasvata Manu. M. ११. ४१; Vi.
(V)--a son of Bali; took part in the तारकामय war. M. १७३. २०; १७७. 7.
(VI)--one of the nine sons of Manu; killed by कृष्ण. वा. ८५. 4; ९८. १००.
--A son of अटमान [पटुमान् (वि। प्।)] and father of हालेय (हालाहल-वि। प्।) भा.
(I)--the son of Purujit [Kurujit (वि। प्।)] and father of श्रुतायुस्. भा. IX. १३. २३; Vi.
(II)--an Asura resident of Tripura. Parti- cipated in the देवासुर war between Bali and Indra. भा.

(III)--the Gandharva presiding over the month of पुष्य;
1: भा. XII. ११. ४२.
called on परीक्षित् practising प्रायोपवेश।
2: Ib. I. १९. 9.
(IV)--(Apratiman) ग्रामणि with the He- manta sun: married four daughters of दक्ष. Br. II. २३. १८; ३७. ४५;

. ५४; वा. ६३. ४२.
married the four daughters of दक्ष and became father of १६ children.
2: Vi. I. १५. १०३, १३४.
(VII)--the यक्ष who resides in the sun's chariot during the month of पौष। Vi. II. १०. १४.
(VI)--a son of Citraka; daughter Sumati, wife of Sagara. Br. III. ७१. ११५; वा. ८८. १५६, १५९; ९६. ११४.
--a second wife of Sagara by name Sumati (s.v.); sister of सुपर्ण. Br. III. ६३. १५५; वा. ८८. १५६, १५९.
--served as calf to milk the earth. Br. II. ३७. १७-18.
--a son of the elephant मृग. Br.

--a daughter of दक्ष, one of कश्यप's wives and mother of Kinnaras and Gandharvas;
1: भा.

and ४५; १४६. १८; वा. ६६. ५५; Vi. I. २१. २५.
expert in music.
2: Br.
--indicators of death; he who would not see अरुन्धती, Dhruva and the shadow of Soma would not live beyond ११ months; and so on; dreams, interpretation of. वा. ch. १९ (whole).
--one of the two अमिताभ गणस्। वा. १००. १६.
